resolutions.rationale: m8_r_owner confirms mitigation preconditions but does not disambiguate. We need dock capacity and partition offset evidence to discriminate whether the lag is physical (dock capacity) or logical (allocation logic). Proceeding with diagnostic to check_dock_capacity.

capability_gaps.reason: Customer impact (duration, scope, financial/operational) requires formal impact assessment, not proxy counts. Blocked until obtained.

If dock has capacity for these orders, points to rule-logic mishandling; if dock is saturated, points to carrier-side constraint.
